description: A few weeks ago, I visited the Strafford County Jail for the first time. I wasn’t there for someone I knew, but to accompany the wife and son of Juan Francisco Mendez, a Guatemalan asylum-seeker who had been wrongfully detained by ICE.

title: Op-Ed: ICE's assault on due process — Alice for New Hampshire
